title: Filtered maps on graded cycles and boundary quotients
statement: Let $C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], $K,K'$ integer-indexed cochain complexes, and $F,F'$ decreasing filtrations [def-sp-filtration]. Let $b:K\to K'$ be a chain map, with restrictions $s_p:F^pK\to F'^pK'$ satisfying $s_p\iota'_p=\iota_pb$. Write $Z_r^{p,q}$ for the graded-cycle subobjects [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients], and $Q_r^{p,q}=Z_r^{p,q}/B_r^{p,q}$ with projection $\pi_r$ [lem-sp-filtered-complex-page-differential]. There exist maps $t_{p,n}:\operatorname{gr}^pK^n\to\operatorname{gr}^pK'^n$, $g_{r,p,q}:Z_r^{p,q}\to Z_r'{}^{p,q}$, and $m_{r,p,q}:Q_r^{p,q}\to Q_r'{}^{p,q}$ for every $r\ge1$. They satisfy $s_p^n\pi'=\pi t_{p,n}$ on the graded projections, $g_{r,p,q}\iota'_Z=\iota_Zt_{p,p+q}$ on cycle inclusions, and $\pi_rm_{r,p,q}=g_{r,p,q}\pi'_r$ on page quotient projections. No spectral sequences, coherence, boundedness or projectivity assumptions are made.

proof.text: Cancel the target step monomorphism to show the restrictions commute with adjacent step inclusions. Apply cokernel.map to obtain the graded-piece complex map T and use cokernel.π_desc degreewise for its projection square.

For a commuting square q;t=s;qprime and U≤pullback(s)(Uprime), the exists/pullback adjunction and its unit give exists(q)(U)≤pullback(t)(exists(qprime)(Uprime)). Factor the source step inclusion through pullback(b)(the target step image), using the restriction equation, to obtain preservation of degreewise filtration steps. Intersections preserve these mapping inequalities by the factorization criterion, and sums by sup_le and pullback monotonicity.

Apply pullback(d) to the filtration-step inequality at p+r and rewrite pullback composition by b.comm. This preserves the cycle representative intersection and its sum with the next step. Pull back along the source step inclusion, rewrite the restriction square, and apply the image-square inequality to the graded projections to get preservation of graded cycles. For boundaries apply the image-square inequality first to d and the restriction of b in degree n-1, then intersect with the pth step, add the next step, pull back and take graded images in the same way.

Use Subobject.factorThru to obtain g on cycles and k on boundaries from these mapping inequalities. Cancel the target cycle inclusion to check that k and g commute with the boundary inclusions. The inclusions exist by boundaries_le_cycles. Apply cokernel.map to this square to construct m, and use cokernel.π_desc to prove its projection square.

theorem filteredComplex_quotient_components
    (K K' : CochainComplex C ℤ) (F : DecreasingFiltration K) (F' : DecreasingFiltration K')
    (b : K ⟶ K')
    (s : ∀ p : ℤ, (F.step p : CochainComplex C ℤ) ⟶
      (F'.step p : CochainComplex C ℤ))
    (hs : ∀ p, s p ≫ (F'.step p).arrow = (F.step p).arrow ≫ b) :
    ∃ (t : ∀ p n : ℤ, (F.gradedPiece p).X n ⟶ (F'.gradedPiece p).X n)
      (g : ∀ (r : ℤ) (_hr : 1 ≤ r) (pq : ℤ × ℤ),
        (F.complexCycles pq.1 (pq.1 + pq.2) r : C) ⟶
          (F'.complexCycles pq.1 (pq.1 + pq.2) r : C))
      (m : ∀ (r : ℤ) (_hr : 1 ≤ r) (pq : ℤ × ℤ),
        filteredComplexPageObject K F r pq ⟶ filteredComplexPageObject K' F' r pq),
      (∀ p n, (s p).f n ≫ (F'.complexQuotientπ p (p + 1) (by omega)).f n =
        (F.complexQuotientπ p (p + 1) (by omega)).f n ≫ t p n) ∧
      (∀ r hr pq, g r hr pq ≫ (F'.complexCycles pq.1 (pq.1 + pq.2) r).arrow =
        (F.complexCycles pq.1 (pq.1 + pq.2) r).arrow ≫ t pq.1 (pq.1 + pq.2)) ∧
      (∀ r hr pq, filteredComplexPageπ K F r pq ≫ m r hr pq =
        g r hr pq ≫ filteredComplexPageπ K' F' r pq)
